ev.q: open world mystery about a solar system trapped in an endless time loop
The planets of Outer Wilds are packed with hidden locations that change with the passage of time
explore the surface of a planet as it crumbles beneath your feet
some of the puzzles can be a little too difficult to figure out
this has been one emotional ride
Having to wait for a timed event throughout the loop to progress forward
Outer Wilds is better experienced in solitude
Мурашки пробивают каждый раз, как я слышу заглавную тему
tedious gameplay that I very much hated
